# Neominds

> AI-Enabled Product Engineering & Full-Spectrum Software Development

## Overview
Neominds is an elite corporate software engineering firm backed by 23 years of execution, delivering custom software, autonomous AI agent pipelines, cloud microservices, and regulated enterprise applications.

## Core Capabilities
- **Design Thinking & Product Discovery**: User-centric product discovery, interaction logic, architectural feasibility, and design systems.
- **Custom Software Development**: High-throughput distributed microservices, clean domain-driven architecture, and resilient enterprise applications.
- **AI & Machine Learning**: Cognitive workflows, LLM orchestration, agentic pipelines, hybrid vector retrieval, and automated RAG evaluation.
- **Cloud & DevOps**: Multi-cloud orchestration (AWS, GCP, Azure), Kubernetes, and automated GitOps CI/CD pipelines.
- **Fintech & Banking Engineering**: Digital banking, payment routing, automated credit underwriting, and sub-25ms fraud detection.
- **Healthcare & Clinical Software**: HIPAA-compliant HIS/EHR interoperability (HL7/FHIR), telemedicine platforms, and medical AI screening.
- **Quality Assurance**: Automated regression testing, performance benchmarking, and chaos engineering drills.

## Operating Principles
- 100% Intellectual Property and source code ownership transfer to clients upon deployment.
- Enterprise-grade 99.99% system availability SLA with multi-region failover.
- Strict security alignment with SOC 2 Type II, ISO/IEC 27001, and HIPAA / HITECH standards.
